faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (Adresse traegt eine session_id, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Odysseus fights for his home while Telemachus seeks news of his father.
kurzfassung: Telemachus journeys to Pylos and Sparta in search of news about his missing father Odysseus, while the faithful Penelope struggles against arrogant suitors at home. Meanwhile, a council of the gods decrees that Odysseus should finally leave Calypso's island and begin his long voyage home. After surviving a fierce storm sent by Neptune, Odysseus washes ashore in Phaeacia, where King Alcinous and Princess Nausicaa receive him with generous hospitality.
stichpunkte: Minerva visits Ithaca disguised as Mentes and urges young Telemachus to call an assembly and search for his father.
Telemachus travels to Pylos and Sparta, where Nestor and Menelaus share stories of the Trojan War and news of heroes.
Back in Ithaca, the arrogant suitors plot to ambush and murder Telemachus upon his return.
Jupiter sends Mercury to Calypso's island to command her to release Odysseus so he can build a raft and sail away.
Neptune spots the voyaging hero and destroys his raft with a massive storm, forcing Odysseus to swim for his life.
With the aid of the goddess Ino and Minerva, Odysseus survives the raging surf and reaches the safety of Phaeacia.
Princess Nausicaa discovers the exhausted hero on the riverbank and guides him toward the magnificent palace of King Alcinous.
King Alcinous warmly welcomes the stranger, provides a feast, and promises a ship for his journey home.

clips.text: The goddess dons her golden sandals and brandishes her bronze spear as she dives from the heights of Olympus straight to Ithaca.
The Spartan king dresses in the early morning, girds his sword, and steps out looking like an immortal god to speak with his young guest.

clips.hook: Odysseus rejoices at the sight of land
clips.text: After surviving days adrift in the deadly sea, the hero feels the same immense relief as children whose sick father recovers from illness.

clips.hook: Aeolus entrusts the winds to Odysseus
clips.text: The ruler of the winds packs all the roaring gales inside an ox-hide bag and ties it shut with silver so only a gentle breeze can guide the ships home.

beschreibung: The Odyssey by Homer is a timeless epic that explores the themes of perseverance, loyalty, and the quest for identity. As Odysseus embarks on his arduous journey home after the Trojan War, he faces numerous trials that test his resolve and ingenuity, ultimately highlighting the human spirit's resilience in the face of adversity. The narrative delves into the complexities of heroism and the importance of home and family, resonating deeply with audiences across generations. Its exploration of the struggles between fate and free will, as well as the consequences of pride and hubris, serves as a powerful reminder of the enduring challenges we face in our own lives. The Odyssey remains a foundational work that speaks to the universal quest for belonging and the trials that define us along the way.
